extracted.name: French Stuffing
extracted.description: This stovetop French stuffing recipe combines ground beef and pork with onion, potato, cinnamon, nutmeg, poultry seasoning, and a hint of brown sugar.
instruction_lines: Cook beef and pork in a large skillet over medium heat until browned.
Stir onion, potatoes, cinnamon, nutmeg, poultry seasoning, brown sugar, and water into ground meats. Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in flour, butter, salt, and pepper and cook until thickened, 5 to 10 minutes.
